lines.text: It’s project time! Make 2–3 animals march in a ScratchJr parade using repeats with chunks, add grow or shrink for showing off, and start them all with the green flag.
Animals march across the screen in a parade.
Each one has its own dance chunk.
Give each animal a chunk (like right, hop) inside a repeat.
Make one animal grow and shrink as it marches — it’s showing off!
Every animal starts on the green flag.
March to the star: right, hop — 4 times — then grow to take a bow!
Stomp, hop, stomp, hop… and a big bow!
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now plan it, build it, test it, and share it!
